title: Draftsperson
abstract: Draftsperson position on Southern Gold Coast. Volume builder - custom homes and interesting wide scoped work in a collaborative drafting team!
bullets: Southern Gold Coast location with flexible hours - ArchiCAD custom builder role
Flexible hours - 2-3pm finishes avail Mon-Thurs, 1pm finishes on Fridays!!
Secure business established over 40 years! Very low staff turnover!
content_text:
- Key technical role across Sales, Estimating & Drafting
- Work across sitings, sales plans, custom designs & complex builds
- Established residential builder with strong workflow and project volume
About the Business
Our client is an established 40 years builder, highly respected and specialising in new home builds across QLD and NSW. Backed by continued growth and a strong pipeline, the business is entering an exciting next phase.
About the Position
Due to growth, a position has been created for an experienced Draftsperson to join the team in a broad role!
Responsibilities will include:
- Prepare sitings, floor plans, elevations and sales plans
- Preparing full working drawings through construction phase
- Review custom and complex jobs
- Assist with new designs and master plans
The successful candidate
Our ideal candidate will be a highly experienced residential draftsperson and will be able to demonstrate the following:
- Minimum 4 years residential drafting experience
- Custom build experience highly regarded
- Effective ArchiCAD skills
- NSW experience advantageous
- Strong problem-solving and attention to detail
Opportunity and Benefits
- Fantastic working hours including 1pm finishes on a Friday and 2-3pm finishes avialalbe on other days!
- Monday - Friday position - no heavy workload or overtime!
- Staff gym on site
- Secure business established over 40 years
- Senior role with continued career progression available!
How to apply
Contact Natalie Hill or Skeilla McLellan on 3177 2723
